2609.15571.title: GRIN+: Towards Fast Yet Effective Machine Unlearning for Imbalanced Medical Data
2609.15571.paper_summary: As deep learning models become fundamental to modern healthcare, the "Right to be Forgotten" mandated by privacy regulations like GDPR and HIPAA necessitates effective machine unlearning (MU) to remove sensitive patient data from trained models. However, existing MU techniques often struggle with a fundamental "privacy-efficiency-utility" (PEU) trilemma, particularly in medical scenarios where data is frequently characterized by severe class imbalance and long-tailed distributions. In such cases, standard unlearning methods can fail to protect key clinical knowledge or mistakenly delete features essential for diagnosing rare conditions due to the gradient dominance of majority classes. To address these challenges, we propose GRIN+, a novel machine unlearning framework designed for fast and precise data erasure in imbalanced medical scenarios. GRIN+ decouples unlearning-specific knowledge from generalized representations at the parameter level by analyzing the gradient contributions of both "forget" and "retain" sets. It introduces a class-adaptive influence scoring mechanism to rectify gradient dominance and employs a direction-constrained update strategy to prevent the unintended erosion of vital clinical knowledge. Comprehensive benchmarking across multiple medical datasets, including skin cancer (ISIC), brain tumor (MRI), and breast ultrasound (BUSI), demonstrates that GRIN+ achieves an optimal balance of the PEU trilemma. Experimental results show that GRIN+ maintains high diagnostic accuracy and robust privacy while significantly enhancing runtime efficiency compared to existing baselines. We open-source the GRIN+ code and benchmarks to support further research.
2609.15571.paper_summary_zh: 隨著深度學習模型成為現代醫療保健的基礎，隱私法規如GDPR和HIPAA所要求的「被遺忘權」需要有效的機器遺忘（MU）來從訓練模型中移除敏感的病人數據。<lb/>然而，現有的MU技術往往面臨一個基本的「隱私-效率-效用」（PEU）三難困境，特別是在醫療場景中，數據經常具有嚴重的類別不平衡和長尾分佈。<lb/>在這種情況下，標準的遺忘方法可能無法保護關鍵的臨床知識，或因為主要類別的梯度主導而錯誤地刪除對於診斷罕見病症至關重要的特徵。<lb/>為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了GRIN+，一種為不平衡醫療場景設計的快速且精確數據刪除的新型機器遺忘框架。<lb/>GRIN+通過分析「遺忘」和「保留」集合的梯度貢獻，將特定於遺忘的知識與參數層級的通用表示解耦。<lb/>它引入了一種類別自適應影響評分機制，以糾正梯度主導，並採用方向約束更新策略，以防止關鍵臨床知識的意外侵蝕。<lb/>在多個醫療數據集上進行的全面基準測試，包括皮膚癌（ISIC）、腦腫瘤（MRI）和乳腺超聲（BUSI），顯示GRIN+實現了PEU三難困境的最佳平衡。<lb/>實驗結果表明，GRIN+在保持高診斷準確性和強大隱私的同時，顯著提高了運行效率，與現有基準相比。<lb/>我們將GRIN+的代碼和基準開源，以支持進一步的研究。
